en.name: Tao Wu
en.ability: Each night*, choose a player: they die. When you would die, instead an alive Minion with an ability loses their ability. You do not receive Demon information.

revisions.v1: Each night*, choose a player: they die. When you would die, instead an alive Minion with an ability loses their ability. You do not receive Demon information.

zh.name: 梼杌
